'''Artesia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWECite" /> located within the [[Artesia system/Legends|Artesia system]], a part of the [[Hangshan sector/Legends|Hangshan sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Artesian space collage]] art form originated on the planet.<ref name="CSWECite" />

==Behind the scenes==
Artesia was first mentioned in the [[1998]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' in the entry for Artesian [[Realspace/Legends|space]] collage.<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The Appendix section of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Artesia [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square P-12, although this was contradicted by its placement in grid square P-11 in the book's map of the Expansion Region.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to ''The Essential Atlas'' later confirmed the placement of the Artesia system in grid square P-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
